description:
Tesla Supercharger invoice fetcher add-on for the Meshmakers Accounting app
(AB#4678). Periodically pulls charging invoices from the Tesla Fleet API and
stages them in the accounting inbox as UploadedDocument entities
(ProcessingState NEW, SourceChannel API) — the existing analysis pipeline
picks them up like any uploaded or e-mailed document; the SHA-256 hash dedup
makes re-polls idempotent.

Installs:
- the Meshmakers.Accounting.Tesla construction kit model (TeslaConfiguration)
- the TeslaConfiguration entity (EMPTY ClientSecret / RefreshToken since
  1.12.3, AB#5929 — never placeholders; placeholder ClientId)
- the "Tesla Charging Invoices" DataFlow with the fetcher pipeline
  (cron via PipelineTrigger, daily 05:30, plus manual ExecutePipeline)

REQUIRES an installed MeshmakersAccounting base blueprint (declared via
blueprintDependencies) — the fetcher stages into the base app's inbox
(Meshmakers.Accounting/UploadedDocument, Documents root folder).

Tesla prerequisites (one-time):
- Tesla developer app (developer.tesla.com) with OAuth grant types
  Authorization Code + Machine-to-Machine and the "Vehicle Charging
  Management" scope; partner registration needs a domain hosting the public
  key at /.well-known/appspecific/com.tesla.3p.public-key.pem
- a refresh token generated once via the localhost OAuth callback

Post-install:
- Set ClientId/ClientSecret/RefreshToken on the TeslaConfiguration entity —
  from the app (Settings -> Add-ons -> Tesla, AB#5035) or via
  scripts/om_set_secrets.ps1 (tesla section). Since 1.1.0 the config
  attributes are isRuntimeState, so a blueprint re-apply/update PRESERVES
  operator values (they are no longer reset to placeholders).
- Since 2.3.0 (Meshmakers.Accounting.Tesla 1.4.0, AB#5929) ClientSecret and
  RefreshToken are SECRET attributes: write-only, stored encrypted, reads
  only report whether they are set; Secret ownership keeps them on every
  re-apply. The fetcher reads the CURRENT refresh token with RevealSecret@1
  (identity ServiceAccount) instead of the deploy-time configuration
  snapshot. REQUIRES a mesh adapter with RevealSecret@1 and the key ring
  (platform release 3.5.18+). After installing 2.3.0, REDEPLOY the "Tesla
  Charging Invoices" DataFlow right away.
- DeployDataFlow "Tesla Charging Invoices" + DeployTriggers (cron) — the
  app's Tesla add-on card does both on "Activate".
- NOTE: Tesla rotates refresh tokens; the pipeline persists the newest token
  back to TeslaConfiguration on every run. isRuntimeState keeps that newest
  token across a re-apply, so it is no longer lost — but a manual
  om_set_secrets run still overwrites it with the secrets.local.json value.
